The '''Skyborn Rangers''' were a group of [[uvak]]-riding [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Lost Tribe]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Founded in [[4975 BBY]] by [[Yaru Korsin]], who placed his daughter [[Nida Korsin|Nida]] in charge of the group, the Rangers were seemingly little more than hobby-riders used casually for public displays. However, the Rangers were actually founded as a countermeasure against the works of [[Adari Vaal]], who conspired to dismantle the leadership of the Sith on Kesh. The Rangers later inspired the clothing worn by the [[uvak wrangler]]s during their [[Rake-riding|competitions]] in the [[Korsinata]], [[3960 BBY|more than a thousand years later]].
